meta.what: DEV (49 clips, gold_AG, 36 needed sounds): where each needed sound is lost in the best DEV arm TO1+F7F8 (TIER + ONCE + R13-1 + F7 + F8; 18/36 hits, 24 wrong (6/12/6), cost 2.45 vs B0r 2.78), and its 24 wrong pictures
meta.split: DEV only; no TEST gold read

sources.stage4: data/work/r13/stage4_r14.json = cluster ~/MscProj/data/work/r13/stage4.json (read-only copy): arms['TO1+F7F8|proposed'] (post-filter rows, 'rescued' flag), r14_dropped (F8 DASM value / ONCE), listener (a_added band rescues, b_kept PANNs-vetoed kept), f7 (mirror-vetoed BEATs spans and the listener's keep decision), mirror
sources.stage5: data/work/r13/TO1+F7F8_proposed (read-only copy of the cluster folder): augmentations.json, gate_votes.json, _stage5_log.json
sources.pictures: score_per_sound.load_pictures on data/work/r13/TO1+F7F8_proposed: 18 hits / 24 wrong = round13_dev.json rows[proposed][TO1+F7F8]; hits agree with needed_changes on 36/36
sources.listener: dev_listener_v.json (Qwen3-Omni V1/V2/V3/V4/V12 accept, V4 text, run peak), dev_listener_afn.json (Audio Flamingo Next V4 accept + text + yes/no); TIER recomputed as the pipeline does: Qwen V4 AND (peak >= 0.6 OR AF V4); pools P2 (band runs) and PV (PANNs-vetoed spans) are the ones the rescue reads; P1 shown for reference
sources.detectors: heard = same-family best frame score in [onset-0.5, onset+1.0] s: BEATs >= 0.175 (benchmark/gold/beats_fw), FlexSED-215 >= 0.4 (data/work/flexsed_cache), PANNs >= 0.1 (benchmark/gold/panns_fw), extra queries >= 0.4 (data/work/flexsed_extra_dev)

meta.hit_rule: dev_candidates_check.needed_hit: same family, picture start in [onset-0.5, onset+1.0] s
meta.cause_rule: first match: unheard; not drawable; rescued then dropped by F8/ONCE/F4; BEATs span dropped by F7; gate visible (same-family stage-5 span with in-window start); timing/merge (a same-family picture covers the onset but starts outside the window); PANNs veto (FlexSED >= 0.8, no stage-4 span); listener rejected (a P2 item in the window, TIER no); else below every bar
meta.wrong_rule: type = the change of score_clip's counts when the picture is added in start order (miss_feats.py); origin = the nearest overlapping same-family stage-4 row: rescued (listener band/PV rescue), FlexSED (FlexSED-only span), BEATs (tagger span)

causes.unheard: no detector reaches its heard bar in the window
causes.below every bar: heard, but under every bar (BEATs display 0.35, FlexSED 0.8) and the listener was not asked
causes.listener rejected: asked; rule TIER said no (Qwen V4 no, or peak < 0.6 and Audio Flamingo V4 no)
causes.killed by F8 (DASM): rescued by the listener, then dropped: DASM below its bar 0.575 in the span +- 0.5 s
causes.killed by ONCE: rescued, then dropped: not the first rescued span of its family
causes.killed by F7: BEATs span dropped by the mirror veto b 0.7 and not confirmed by the listener
causes.PANNs veto: FlexSED >= 0.8 span dropped by the PANNs clip veto, PV listener item said no
causes.gate visible: a same-family span reached stage 5 and the gate called the source visible
causes.timing / merge: a same-family picture exists but starts outside [onset - 0.5, onset + 1.0] s
